config.rationale: Tests a structurally different backbone (resnet18) that introduces batch-norm, multi-scale feature maps, and skip connections beyond the custom residual_cnn. Learning rate halved to 5e-4 and batch size reduced to 64 to stabilize training of the deeper network. Retains the proven adamw+cosine pairing, standardize normalization, all three augmentations, and class weighting. If resnet18 matches or beats the residual_cnn, it confirms that richer inductive bias (BN, multi-resolution) is the key factor rather than the specific residual block design.
